FAQS

Clear answers.
A confident next step.

Start with these common questions or speak with the team about your requirement.

YOUR QUESTIONS, ANSWERED

For organizations.

Can you support multiple locations?+

GA Digital Web Word reports a pan-India presence managed through 11 zonal offices. Contact the team to confirm coverage and arrangements for your specific locations.

What should we include in a staffing enquiry?+

Share the roles, work locations, expected workforce size, skills, proposed start date and engagement duration. The team can then discuss a suitable scope.

Is payroll support available?+

Payroll generation and administration are documented GA Digital Web Word capabilities. Their inclusion and responsibilities should be agreed for your engagement.

YOUR QUESTIONS, ANSWERED

For candidates.

Are all published jobs still open?+

Please check the current listing on Frevone for availability, closing dates and application instructions.

How do I apply?+

Open Careers to visit Frevone, choose a role and follow the application steps there. Job listings and applications are managed on Frevone.

Does GA Digital Web Word charge a job-placement fee?+

A one-time service fee of ₹11,000 is mandatory if you are placed through GA Digital Web Word. This fee is payable to GA Digital Web Word and is non-refundable.

Where can I raise a recruitment or employee concern?+

Use the grievance and support page or email info@gadigital.in. Include the project or vacancy reference and a concise description of the concern.

Still have a question?

Whether you represent an organization or are looking for work, our team can help.
